def bfs_get_region(start_cell, cells):
    from collections import deque
    region = set()
    q = deque([start_cell])
    visited = set()
    while q:
        r, c = q.popleft()
        if (r,c) in visited: continue
        visited.add((r,c))
        region.add((r,c))
        for dr in [-1, 0, 1]:

    H, W = 7, 20
    visited = set()

        q = deque([(r, c)])
        comp = set()

                    if 0 <= nr < H and 0 <= nc < W and (nr, nc) in zeros and (nr, nc) not in visited:

def find_zero_components(zeros):
    H, W = 7, 20
    visited = set()

        q = deque([(r, c)])

        while q:
            curr = q.popleft()
            if curr in visited:

            visited.add(curr)
            comp.add(curr)
            for dr in [-1, 0, 1]:
                for dc in [-1, 0, 1]:

                    nr, nc = curr[0] + dr, curr[1] + dc
                    if 0 <= nr < H and 0 <= nc < W and (nr, nc) in zeros and (nr, nc) not in visited:
